newsitem.title: UK: EMU could provoke intolerance - UK Labour's Dobson.
newsitem.headline: EMU could provoke intolerance - UK Labour's Dobson.

text.p: If countries joining the EU single currency do not have convergent economies, the move could provoke "the worst manifestations of nationalism and intolerance," a senior Labour politician warned on Friday.
Frank Dobson, the opposition Labour Party's environment spokesman, said this possibility meant that the decision on whether Britain should join would be a tough one.

Dobson told a construction industry conference in Solihull, central England, there were "important advantages" to joining up to a single currency, including greater interest rate stability and reduced transaction costs.

However, he added, unless the economies of participating countries were "genuinely and substantially" convergent, weaker economies could get into severe trouble, causing severe social and political upheaval.
"The likely consequences of this would be an upsurge of the worst manifestations of nationalism and intolerance. So there's a lot at stake. That's why we need to be careful and prudent," Dobson said.
"When the terms and conditions are known, we can make a judgement. And I don't think it will be an easy decision," he added. -- London Newsroom +44 171 5427767
